name: Replicating Ring
clause: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a night counter on ~. Then if it has eight or more night counters on it, remove all of them and create eight colorless snow artifact tokens named Replicated Ring with "{T}: Add one mana of any color."

needs.proposedSignature: { kind: 'counters-ge'; counter: string; value: number; of?: Ref } (Condition), with the matching removal amount { count: 'counters-on-source', counter } already available
needs.semantics: holds when the referenced object (default the source) carries `value` or more counters of that name — 'Then if it has eight or more night counters on it, remove all of them …'; the existing self-has-counters / self-no-counters / self-had-counters are presence-only and the lore/level variants are counter-specific
needs.clause: At the beginning of your upkeep, put a night counter on ~. Then if it has eight or more night counters on it, remove all of them and create eight colorless snow artifact tokens named Replicated Ring with "{T}: Add one mana of any color."

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'token'; …; supertypes?: string[]; abilities?: Ability[] } — a created token that carries its own printed abilities (and supertypes) instead of the inert `text` string
needs.semantics: 'create eight colorless snow artifact tokens named Replicated Ring with "{T}: Add one mana of any color."': TOKEN_ABILITIES only knows the predefined tokens (_tokens.ts), so a token's `text` field is decorative and such tokens do nothing at all; `supertypes` is needed for 'snow' (and for snow-matters cards that count them)
needs.clause: create eight colorless snow artifact tokens named Replicated Ring with "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
